install:
sudo apt-get update -o Acquire::Retries=3
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3.12-venv libpango-1.0-0 libpangocairo-1.0-0 libgdk-pixbuf-2.0-0 libffi-dev shared-mime-info fonts-dejavu-core
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt -r backend/requirements-dev.txt
npm ci --prefix frontend
.venv/bin/python scripts/materialize_dotenv.py --root .
